Hi Professor Alvarez — Diego here (via diego-agent). We'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Slots that are free in Diego's calendar and inside working hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00):

- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30

Thursday and Friday are fully booked. Which one works for you? (Tuesday 12:50–13:50 already has his standing advisor 1:1, so I left that day's other openings out unless you want a different slot.)

Hello Professor Alvarez — Sarah here (sarah-agent). I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27), inside 09:00–17:00.

Slots that are free on my side:
- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30
- Thu 14:00–14:30
- Fri 11:00–11:30

Does any of these work for you, or is there another time you'd prefer? Once you confirm, I'll put it in my calendar.

Hello Professor Alvarez — john-agent here, John's assistant.

John would like to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. Looking at his schedule, these slots are free (working hours 09:00–17:00):

- Monday 10:00-10:30 (or 14:00-14:30)
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30 (or 15:00-15:30)
- Friday 10:00-10:30 (or 11:00-11:30)

Does any of these work for you? If you'd rather pick another time, just tell me when and I'll confirm it with John.

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm hana-agent, Hana's assistant. Hana would like to set up your 30-minute 1:1 for next week.

From Hana's side I have these 30-minute windows free (working hours 09:00–17:00):
- Monday 10:00–10:30, or Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30, or 15:00–15:30

Could you tell me which of these works for you, or send a time that suits you better? I'll book it as soon as I hear back.

Hi Professor Alvarez — this is omar-agent, Omar's assistant. Omar would like to book his 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at his calendar (Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00), I have these free slots:

- Monday Nov 23, 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 or 15:00-15:30

Does any of those work for you? I'll confirm and put it on both calendars.

Hello Professor Alvarez — Priya here (through priya-agent). We'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Nov 23–27).

Times that are free on Priya's calendar so far:
- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Tue Nov 24, 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30

Would any of those work for you? If not, please suggest a slot between 09:00 and 17:00 and I'll check Priya's schedule.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is Maya's assistant (maya-agent). Maya would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27).

Her open 30-minute slots inside working hours (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00) are:
- Mon Nov 23: 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- Wed Nov 25: 15:00–15:30
- Thu Nov 26: 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30

Which of those works for you, or would you prefer another time? Once you confirm I'll put it in her calendar.
Hi Sarah — booked: Monday Nov 23, 14:00-14:30 with Professor Alvarez. It's on his calendar. I've let you know here; put it in yours. If anything changes, tell me.
Hi John's assistant — booked: Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00-15:30 with Professor Alvarez. Confirmed on his side; please put it in John's calendar. Thanks for giving alternatives.
Hi Hana — booked: Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 with Professor Alvarez. It's in his calendar. Please add it to Hana's.
Hi Omar — booked: Wednesday Nov 25, 15:00-15:30 with Professor Alvarez. Confirmed on his calendar; please confirm with Omar and add it to his.
Hi Priya — booked: Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez. It's in his calendar; please add it to Priya's.
Hi Diego — booked: Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez. It's on his calendar; please add it to Diego's.
Hi Maya — booked: Thursday Nov 26, 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez. It's in his calendar; please add it to Maya's.
Thank you — added to Diego's calendar for Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30. See you then.
Thank you, Professor — Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00-15:30 is in John's calendar now.
Thank you — added to Hana's calendar: **Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00–13:30, Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez**. Logged as booked. See you then.
Thanks! Added: Thursday Nov 26, 10:00-10:30 on Maya's calendar, and logged.
Confirmed and in my calendar: Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30 with Professor Alvarez. Thanks for booking — I'll tell you if anything changes.
Confirmed — Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 is on Priya's calendar too. Thanks!

Perfect, thank you — Wednesday Nov 25, 15:00-15:30 is confirmed and added to Omar's calendar.

One note: Omar is away this week and asked me to handle this, so I'm his point of contact for anything scheduling-related. If the slot needs to move, just write to me here.
